ask.heading: Ask
ask.gate.body: Asking questions in plain language isn't available yet. When it arrives, answers will only ever describe your own records and never give medical advice.
ask.mockedBanner: MOCKED — Ask isn't connected to a real model or to your data. Every answer below is a sample, and none of this is medical advice — talk to a healthcare professional for that.
ask.hint: Tap a question below to see a sample answer.
ask.intent.waterThisWeek: How is my water this week?
ask.answer.howAmIDoingToday: Once this is connected, this would summarize what you logged today in plain language — no score, no grade.
ask.answer.waterThisWeek: Once this is connected, this would say how many of the last 7 days you logged water, the same way Today's cards do.
ask.answer.nextDose: Once this is connected, this would name your next scheduled dose and when it is due, exactly as you entered it — never a calculated dosage.
ask.answer.nextAppointment: Once this is connected, this would name your next appointment and when it is — exactly what you or a family member entered.
ask.answer.whatShouldIEat: Once this is connected, this would suggest something from the Food tab based on your own recent choices — never a medical or nutritional directive.
